name: task_update
description: Update fields on an existing task card. Only the fields you pass will change. Pass `script` to overwrite the bash body on disk.

name.description: Name of the task card to update.

check_interval.description: New cadence in seconds between script runs (must be > 0).

script.description: New bash body for core/tasks/<name>.sh. Last line must be `[skip]`, `[start]`, `[start] <message>`, or `[done]`.
